granularity: Each row is a reviewed operation family; overloads with the same implementation and evidence share a row.

sourceAudit.scope: All selected-profile framework files containing explicit NativeUnavailableError or NotSupportedException construction were reviewed into the operation families below. Internal construction guards share their public operation family.
